item.title: UW appoints John Zumbrunnen as provost following national search
item.description: University of Wisconsin political science professor John Zumbrunnen will serve as the UW provost and executive vice chancellor for academic affairs following a national search, Chancellor Jennifer Mnookin announced March 9. item.title: How to vote in the 2026 spring elections
item.description: As the April 7 spring elections in Wisconsin approach, students can find numerous voting resources before casting their ballots, according to BadgersVote. item.title: UW seminar focuses on burning events, population dynamics of midwestern prairies
item.description: The Department of Forest and Wildlife Ecology at the University of Wisconsin held a seminar March 11. It focused on the relationship between the effects of fires and habitat fragmentation on population dynamics of narrow-leaved purple coneflower, Echinacea angustifolia, on the ever fragmenting prairies of western Minnesota. item.description: University of Wisconsin faculty were found to be significantly more liberal than the general American public in a poll published March 8 by UW’s Tommy G.
